checklist: S9: a folder named 'Shoot 2026 #1 & 50% (é) + more', holding a file named 'a+b=c?d&e#f 50%41.ARW', one named 'Café.ARW' (NFD: e + combining accent) and a subfolder 'Café ?=', opens, reads every photo (head, preview, thumb by lumina:// URL), keeps one and saves its sidecar under the RAW's own name. Before the fix the read stalled on a space: URLSearchParams wrote it as '+' and the scheme handler read '+' as a plus (404).
